title: Sea-Breeze
summary: SE'A-BREEZE, noun [sea and breeze.] A wind or current of air blowing from the sea upon land; for the most part blowing during the day only, and subsiding at night.

inlines.v: SE'A-BREEZE, noun [sea and breeze.] A wind or current of air blowing from the sea upon land; for the most part blowing during the day only, and subsiding at night.
